translations.en: A crumpled note lay at your feet.
"My sense of balance..."
Shaky letters were written on the wall.
"Where... am I...?"
"There is more than one key."
Rough letters were carved into the floor.
"Our caster's magic is completely gone!
We're doooooomed!"
A small piece of paper lay at your feet.
"And now, let the hell of endless doors begin!"
A breeze seemed to be blowing from nearby.
Yet it was also flowing toward the northeast.
A thick book lay at your feet.
"There is more than one way forward."
Rough lettering covered the door,
as though scratched into it with a sword.
"These doors are so damn annoying!!!"
A tattered note lay on the ground.
"I'm not lost. I just don't know which way to go."
A scrap of paper lies on the ground.

translations.en: "Where was I going next, again?"
Something like a battered journal
lay at your feet.
You opened it,
but all its pages had fallen out.
Something like a scrap from a notebook lay on the ground.
"The season of... Cloudy.
We departed from town, determined that today
we would finally finish exploring this labyrinth."
"Our party consists of myself, a priest, two fighters, a lord,
a skilled ninja, and a sorcerer.
With this party, we should have no trouble."
"I suppose this is to be expected of unexplored territory.
Even the monsters we encounter are unlike those we have seen before.
Still, creatures of this caliber are no match for us."
"Ah, it must be their fur.
I am terribly envious. Next time I come here,
I shall wear a thicker robe."
"It is a little cold. Perhaps I should have dressed more warmly.
Why do the Felpurr feel no chill,
despite wearing so little?"
"The dwarf woman is an exceptionally reliable fighter.
Her youthful appearance puzzled me at first,
but her tremendous strength is truly something to behold."
"When I learned that the lord and fighter were parent and child,
I was surprised, but it also made sense."
"The enemies seem to be getting a little stronger.
I would like to conserve my magic as well.
I cannot afford to waste a single spell."
"Whenever we find a treasure chest, our Porklu companion
always disarms its traps.
He is not suited to fighting, but he is useful at times like these.
Monsters are not the only things that can kill us."
"During the last battle, my hat got caught high overhead.
But our male fighter retrieved it and returned with ease.
Perhaps that splendid agility comes naturally to his race."
"My party has equal numbers of men and women.
It feels rather embarrassing at times,
but everyone has their strengths and weaknesses."
"The fairy crashed into a pillar and was left seeing stars.
I have warned them so many times
not to look away while flying."
Something is written on the wall.

translations.en: "I can't stop thinking about that person."
"I found that person's house."
Something was written on the wall in shaky letters.
"I found out what that person likes."
"Damn it. One of the dwarves has been badly wounded.
Letting our guard down was our undoing. I am our only healer.
I cannot afford to cast a spell here yet."
"By now, nearly everyone in the party is battered and bruised.
But according to the old writings, we should be
very close to reaching the end of this labyrinth..."
"We cannot go on. The wounded woman fighter is being carried by the lord.
And yet we must be close, so very close.
I want to know what lies ahead!"
"I cannot contain my excitement.
This place that no one has ever explored to the end! I, of all people,
will be the first to discover its secrets!"
"I persuaded everyone that we should press on.
